title: Compact-support base-change square
statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme and let

$$
\begin{array}{ccc}
X'&\xrightarrow{g'}&X\\
f'\downarrow&&\downarrow f\\
Y'&\xrightarrow{g}&Y
\end{array}
$$

be a cartesian square of
$S$-schemes with $f:X\to Y$
separated and of finite
type; no hypothesis on $g$ is made. A
*compactification of $f$* is a factorization

$$
X\xrightarrow{\ j\ }\overline X\xrightarrow{\ p\ }Y
$$

with $j$ an open immersion and $p$ a
proper $S$-morphism and
$pj=f$, as in
[def-weil-compactifications-refinements]; write
$c=(j,p)$. For the base change $g:Y'\to Y$, put

$$
\overline X'=\overline X\times_YY',\qquad
X'=X\times_YY'
$$

with the projections $\bar g':\overline X'\to\overline X$,
$p':\overline X'\to Y'$, $j':X'\hookrightarrow\overline X'$
(the base change of the open immersion), and
$g':X'\to X$; by base-change stability of open immersions and proper morphisms
[lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-base-change, lem-weil-pbc-proper-base-change] the data $c'=(j',p')$ form a
compactification of $f'$.

lean.statement:
noncomputable def baseChange {f : X ⟶ S} (c : Compactification f) (t : T ⟶ S) :
    Compactification (pullback.snd f t)
lean.note: Existing construction in WeilConjectures/Compactification/BaseChange.lean:146–148. Its ambient scheme is pullback c.g t, proper projection pullback.snd c.g t, and open immersion the induced pullback lift. ofIsPullback handles the initially given Cartesian square. The construction applies without extra assumptions to the separated finite-type S-morphism of this node; the S-structure on the ambient scheme is induced by c.g and Y → S. No new notion or module is needed.
